notes.title: The 0.6 update is here!
notes.notes:
[p]This update brings two big new features, plus a bunch of smaller ones that make everything feel more polished. Let’s start with the big ones.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW PLANET: VANADIAN[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/7c53cf0db8dc5e4b03b6d73902445ba9417cc096.gif"][/img][/p][p]Vanadian, the labyrinth-like desert of SR755, comes to Farlands with new resources, a unique day-night cycle, and a merchant packed with fresh and interesting stuff.[/p][p][/p][p]When you land, look for Bob the merchant. He sells unique seeds, new furniture, and strange artifacts. But since he’s a desert dweller, you’ll need to track him down across different areas of the planet.[/p][p]
Be careful if you arrive at night, because instead of insects, hostile mobs you’ll normally see in the mines will spawn.[/p][p]
And do you see that buried pyramid? It might be hiding something important for late game...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/265d6e4a0c8ed3b19867996ee08d2c59a1a08eb7.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]CALENDAR EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/af040aebebbaa25769a75e236e43a0b557a3b924.gif"][/img][/p][p]Nine new events have been added to Farlands, seven on Terbin and two on Galea. Unlike the story events, these ones appear if you travel to those planets on specific days. They’re small events, but they’re a great chance to see new NPC interactions, buy unique items and artifacts from shops, and dive a little deeper into the world of Farlands and its characters.[/p][p]
With this new event type, you’ll now see icons on the system map showing available events. That includes story, tutorials, bachelors, and this new calendar events.[/p][p]
After those two big new additions, let’s go through the smaller ones:[/p][list][*][p][b]New story event[/b]: You can now see up to 50% of the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options improvements[/b]: Windowed mode and resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New furniture sets[/b]: Vanadian inspired.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New collectible[/b]: The Floots, scattered all across the system. They’re not required for 100% but they’re pretty cool.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New recipe chip shop[/b]: Iriel now sells chips and food.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New lighting system in Terbin, Bohr, and Galea:[/b] Each planet gets dark at different hours, so watch out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New animations for Iriel and Te’Kragh[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]General bug fixing[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]WHAT’S NEXT?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Now it’s time to work on 0.7, the quality of life update. Truth is, we already have it pretty far along, but all that progress will “get spent” because first we need to update the Unity version we’re using, and that might break some things.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/e7d90f6df92e73a5b64dcadec36a206e92082f95.gif"][/img][/p][p]We need to do this because Farlands started on a Unity version that will soon lose support. It’s better to rip off the band-aid now and make the jump to a newer version right alongside the quality of life update.[/p][p]
We’ve already tested it and it doesn’t seem too bad, but even so Rubén and Néstor, our programmers, will spend a couple of weeks making sure nothing explodes and all systems hold up fine.[/p][p][/p][p]Once we get past that hurdle, we’ll let you know and continue with the roadmap toward 0.7, which should arrive sometime in October (fingers crossed).[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for your support and enjoy 0.6![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: How are things going?
notes.notes:
[p][i]From the ashes emerged a developer. Sluggish and sore, as if he hadn't moved in a decade… and his first words after a silence that felt eternal were:[/i][/p][p][/p][p]EVERYTHING IS GOING GREAT[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the radio silence since version 0.5. We've been completely swamped with work, but I can now say that everything is going smoothly. So in this update, I’ll explain how things are going and what you can expect in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What are we working on?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Right now, given the usual processes and expected bottlenecks of development, we are working on three updates at the same time.[/p][p]There are still a few loose ends from 0.5 that will be resolved soon. Things like balance adjustments, sound effects, and other small details. Nothing important, but it all needs to be finalized.[/p][p]Version 0.6 has all the programming finished, so we’re currently working on the content itself. That includes dialogues, translations, events, balancing the new planet, and all the pieces that make it up. It’s nearly ready and will be released on the experimental branch in the coming weeks, and then on the main branch.[/p][p]Finally, since the programming for 0.6 is done, the programmers have been working ahead on version 0.7 for about a month now. That means the update should arrive a bit earlier than expected. Or at the very least, the wait will not be as long as it has been with 0.6.[/p][p]With that out of the way, what is coming in the next updates? Here’s a quick summary.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s in 0.6?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This version brings two important new features.[/p][p]First, calendar events. These are celebrations you can attend both on Terbin and Galea if you visit those planets on specific days. Farlands will have nine of these celebrations. They are all small events, but you’ll be able to enjoy new dialogues, unique character interactions, and new vendors who will bring a variety of items, collectibles, recipes, and more. They are worth attending.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/af040aebebbaa25769a75e236e43a0b557a3b924.gif"][/img][/p][p]Second, a new planet. The Vanadian desert, where you’ll encounter several insects, unique resources, and a slippery merchant who will sell you new seeds and some very strange items.[/p][p]Also, buried in Vanadian lies a peculiar structure whose mystery you will be able to uncover with the release of version one point zero. That is post-game content, so no questions yet.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/7c53cf0db8dc5e4b03b6d73902445ba9417cc096.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]And 0.7?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on quality of life improvements. There will not be any major new features or systems, but instead we will address things the community has been requesting since day one. We will also give the project a bit of cleanup, because it’s starting to feel dusty.[/p][p]You can expect things like button remapping, better feedback and usability in shops and menus, shortcuts for chest actions, improved tooltips, a rework of the early hours of gameplay, and a few fun surprises such as the speeder, which Néstor coded this week as a surprise.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/e7d90f6df92e73a5b64dcadec36a206e92082f95.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]What does the future hold?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Oddly enough, we are following the roadmap with surprising accuracy. It looks like we will be able to stick to a schedule similar to the original plan. The release date for version one point zero is still a bit uncertain, but everything points to early twenty twenty-six. That gives us time for polish and bug fixing. And although zero point six has taken longer than expected, we are making up for it with an earlier zero point seven.[/p][p]Farlands is getting dangerously close to version one point zero, and for the team, it feels a bit surreal. We’ve been working on this project for two years, and what once felt so distant that we could barely imagine it is now a weekly topic of discussion. There is a strange mix of excitement for what is coming and nostalgia for what we are about to leave behind.[/p][p]But before I get too sentimental, it is time to get back to work. There is still a lot of content to add, many fixes to make, and many systems waiting.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Hostile Mobs Have Arrived in Farlands!
notes.notes:
After the update that introduced social relationships, the whole team jumped straight into the next big thing: version 0.5, which brings hostile mobs to the mines.
In this Steam post, I’ll walk you through what’s new and how we’re planning to roll out the upcoming content over the next few weeks.

[b]HOSTILE MOBS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/0ee5fc1fe7ed18a4491820233c596a56faeb309d.gif[/img]

The main highlight of this update is the introduction of hostile mobs. Since version 0.1, the only mine in the game featured the Murlusas—a small proof of concept of what enemies in Farlands might be like.
From now until the final version, we’ve got a total of 18 enemies planned—six for each of the three mines in Farlands, each with its own behavior and mechanics.
But for this 0.5 update, you’ll get to meet just four enemies for now: two in Bohr and two in Hafnir.
Every Farlands enemy has been designed with unique behavior—rolling turtles that smash rocks, robots that steal your stuff, crystal bees that hatch from nests and protect them… Each one brings something different to the table. And because of that complexity, we’d rather introduce them slowly and make sure they work well than rush them all in at once and risk things breaking.
So, starting now, we’ll be adding one or two new enemies every couple of weeks until they’re all in the game. This way, we can make sure each one is solid and won’t blow up your game.

[b]NEW MINE – HAFNIR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/42e38e227e5dcc8f5775d1c8c148ba2d0816e441.gif[/img]

Alongside these new enemies, you’ll now be able to explore Hafnir Mine, which had been locked until now. Inside, you’ll find 100 levels full of secrets, rewards, and a tragic story—but we’ll leave that part for you to uncover.
This mine uses a unique checkpoint system different from Bohr’s, with mine carts you’ll have to repair using scrap scattered throughout the levels. But just like in Bohr, if you’re feeling bold, you can skip levels and go deeper straight away (at your own risk, of course).

[b]NEW EVENTS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/79784efae62975bd419a360a5ef3cc94199e5c5c.gif[/img]

This update also adds 10 new social events: a new piece of the main story, a moment with Hunter in the new mine, and the next step in your relationships with the bachelors and bachelorettes.
The stories of the different characters are evolving in some really exciting ways, and we highly recommend diving into that side of Farlands to get to know them better.

[b]STEAM DECK SUPPORT[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/f62b8ce3a0bbb934c1bf68a9b9d170182c8f68f4.png[/img]

It took us a few weeks of headaches and fixes, but Steam has officially certified Steam Deck support. Finally!
We’ll keep improving controller support, menu usability, and we also plan to add features like button remapping in the future. But for now, Farlands is fully playable on Steam Deck, and we’ve earned that coveted green checkmark.

[b]NEW FURNITURE, ACHIEVEMENTS & BUG FIXES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/bc6a6cc18a6c6d328eea8fd75793bc77e8ab3587.png[/img]

And of course, like every update, version 0.5 brings two new furniture sets, this time inspired by Hafnir. You’ll also find new achievements tied to the added content and a big batch of bug fixes, balancing changes, and general polish—the usual upgrade pack that brings us a little closer to the final version of Farlands.

While everything listed here is already available in the game, due to how we’re handling enemy rollout, this update will unfold gradually over time. We hope you understand that this approach is all about doing what’s best for the long-term health of Farlands. We’d rather give things the time they need than rush them out half-baked.
Thanks so much for your support!

notes.title: 0.4 is here!
notes.notes:
Originally this update was scheduled for February (because of love, Valentine's Day and all that stuff). But ultimately, we decided to delay it a couple of weeks with the purpose of releasing a fully finished and well rounded update. And I think we have done it, because it comes loaded with new features:

[b]Social relations system.[/b]

This is the most important point of this update and the one that gives its name to it: The social relations system is now fully implemented and from now on you will be able to progress your relationship with the other characters.

So far, it is possible to raise them to the second level (out of six), and you will do this by talking to them, joking, flirting or giving them gifts, which they may like or dislike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/dcc769f3a6294dee557fd9b91a5f0f7052b12ec1.gif[/img]

[b]First relationship event available[/b]

In addition to the social relationship system, once you reach the first level with any of the eight romanceable candidates, you will be able to see the first of the relationship events with them. This will allow you to get to know them a little better, and start their stories.

As with the social relationship system, each update after this point will include eight new events, one for each romanceable candidate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/24b0598b25cfcbddcb560fa85fb853d5743f8e42.gif[/img]

[b]Messaging system[/b]

Complementing all these social systems, a new tab and a new system has been added to the main menu: The messaging system.

From now on you will receive emails on specific days, after seeing certain events or before important things happen.

At the moment there are only a handful of emails ready, but more will be added so you can soak in the world of Farlands and its characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/f1d0487cac5030dfc6b0ca3e17e5191b6dd72aa9.gif[/img]

[b]Complete rework of the menu[/b]

And of course, since we were working on this new tab in the main menu, we took the opportunity to do a complete refactoring and cleaning of the rest of the main menu tabs.

It is not something that you will notice directly in the gameplay, but now the navigation is smoother, the menus are better organized, the graphics are cleaner... It's all a little better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/4386223cbbccf705b97ca224f5f724cd6d8f595d.gif[/img]

[b]Others[/b]

And we could really finish here the update and it would be a good one. But we already warned you that this one came packed, because along with all these new systems, we have added or fixed the following things:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Ultra-Wide support[/b]: If you're playing with an absurdly large screen, you should no longer have problems with interface sizes.

[*] [b]Accessibility option to increase the size of the interfaces[/b]: Text is too small? Don't worry! Now you can enlarge it with an option in the menu.

[*] [b]Improved SteamDeck support[/b]: Short of re-passing certification, small things have been fixed that made the gameplay on SteamDeck not optimal, now it should be much more comfortable.

[*] [b]Improved controller control[/b]: The mouse is no longer annoying on the screen and navigation with controller is more comfortable.

[*] [b]Sprinklers[/b]: Sprinklers of levels higher than basic now work and can be crafted, and not only that: Now they can also be rotated. How crazy!

[*] [b]Three new furniture sets to unlock and discover[/b]: Two Goddol-inspired furniture sets and a third one in modern style.

[*] [b]New achievements available[/b]: All those related to the new systems in this update.

[*] [b]General game polish[/b]: Minor fixes all over the place and little things that are not visible to the naked eye, but make the experience smoother and more enjoyable.

And finally, the most important of all.

[*] [b]From now on Gorg does this sometimes[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/6bb692add185c732b45df7e9783ecc6667cab106.gif[/img]

[/list]

Now that we're releasing this update, we'll be keeping an eye out for a couple of weeks for possible issues that come up, and sooner rather than later we'll get to 0.5, which will focus on hostile Mobs and improving the Farlands mining experience.

Thank you all very much for your patience and love, this project would not be possible without you!

notes.title: A big update is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a few weeks since the last update and it's about time we bring you all up to date, so let's get straight to the point:

In two weeks update 0.4 will arrive!

This update focuses mainly on NPCs, bachelors, dialogs and mails.

To give you an idea of the scope of this update, we estimate that over 1000 new lines of dialogue will be added to Farlands!

That is: The first love event with each bachelor and bachelorette, emails that you will be able to receive on your PDA, dialogues that will vary depending on the progress of the story or your relationship with the NPCs... The complete pack.

We are convinced that this update will be very worthwhile and will give a new (and expected) layer of depth to Farlands to bring the game a little closer to version 1.0.

We will update you very shortly with all the details of what this new update will include, so stay tuned.

Thank you very much for your patience and support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/be664d9d9077cd97c3bd82af4d24ccc329caf84d.png[/img]

notes.title: We have a Christmas present for you!
notes.notes:
After the release of 0.3, the next scheduled update is 0.4 which focuses on social relations with neighbors. However, since that update is still some time away, the Farlands team has prepared an intermediate update with some special Christmas content, to celebrate the holidays, and to make the wait more enjoyable. The update comes with the following content:

[b]A new planet! GODDOL[/b]

The colorful, tropical and sunny planet Goddol has been added to the destinations you can explore. There you will find new insects, fish, artifacts, resources, beautiful views and Hunter, with whom you will be able to talk a little bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/54e11cdefbcafd97554fb2008350f2d98de12c67.gif[/img]

[b]Weather effects![/b]

(Here we are cheating a bit because this was part of 0.3, don't tell anyone). Weather effects have already been implemented in your farm: different types of rain, heat waves, snow, wind and even a storm so strong that you won't be able to leave your house for a day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/8e70b4c53241473b26f5910db6c35423f0c323f7.gif[/img]

[b]New Christmas furniture![/b]

Available in some of the stores, you can now buy some Christmas furniture to decorate your farm or your home: some gifts, a Christmas tree and even a typical Catalan Christmas decoration: “The Caga Tió”, a log that shits gifts when it is hit (local traditions are very odd).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/cd8bd72f5e0107eda3d08285ac10d170468e8834.gif[/img]

[b]And more![/b]

Along with these additions, important fixes have also been made, both related to game balance and bug fixes: the tooltips have been simplified to make them more usable, the different types of weeds have been unified to make it less confusing, the Ark has undergone changes and new items have been added and we have polished many things related to the localization.

[b]So what's next?[/b]

After this update comes the holidays. Right now we have a programmer on vacation, the designer is leaving next week and everyone wants to rest a bit and join their loved ones to celebrate Christmas. So, although we will continue working, we will also be a few days off, the team has earned it.

Happy holidays to all and see you in 2025 with more updates!

notes.title: 0.3 UPDATE IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Let's not pretend, in the last few weeks the whole Farlands team has been a bit hidden and not saying much. But it was for a reason: Update 0.3 is already available, and the amount of content it adds to the game is dizzying.

In this post we are going to review every single new feature that you can enjoy in Farlands starting today, and if anyone is hesitating whether to get in to play now, or wait a little longer, this update comes with a sweet 10% discount during the Steam sales.

With this out the way, let's get started!

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/ac5e7c2424fe9e59c07bcaf7195df217ea1c80f6.png[/img]

One of the most requested things by the community; a very large list of achievements with objectives to accomplish, has been added to Farlands. In total there are 50 achievements, although since many of them cannot be obtained yet. Only those that can be obtained will be available on Steam, the rest will be added in later updates.

The achievement system is also integrated into the game, in one of the collections tabs, and connected to Steam, granting players the achievements retroactively.

[b]TOOL UPGRADE SYSTEM[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/97da6915f6a014b31a98a5d87bf2ce2ee3a60cd4.png[/img]

A classic of the management games, but that has taken us some time because of the complexity of the system.

From now on, talking to Gorg in Terbin, you will be able to upgrade your primary tools, by doing so, in addition to increasing their power, the tools will expand their range of action.

Using them in the mine is very rewarding.

[b]FOOD[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/fe427eff94eafb21569cccd116719b2efc13b688.png[/img]

And just talking about the mine. A system that is more than necessary to be able to advance more easily and make the most of the days, is the food system, which from this update is now fully functional.

In the crafting machine, gathering the necessary ingredients, you will be able to cook different dishes to recover energy. My personal recommendation: Farmer's tea, although you have about 30 different dishes available to try out recipes.

[b]HOUSE UPGRADE SYSTEM[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/46547bc272152e1b607ffb7888bd4bb06e50b0b8.png[/img]

And this is still going on, your house can now be upgraded by talking to Grubert, the carpenter of Galea. For a small fee and some resources, he will use his carpentry skills to fix and enlarge your house.

[b]NEW FURNITURE AND INTERIOR DECORATION[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/8f30cfa3b5e3eb1dc24f4aafbc7120cb645b1ff8.png[/img]

And what to do with a huge mansion? Decorate it, of course. Because from 0.3 you will be able to craft more than 40 new pieces of furniture, and use them both indoors and outdoors. The sprites that have accompanied you at home since day 1, you can now remove them, they are now furniture with which you can interact.

[b]GUESTS AND BETTER NPC[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/8370ef101b74193cb9d755fa43a4109c05a65579.png[/img]

And if you visit Terbin to buy some of the chips needed to unlock the furniture crafts, you may find spaceships parked next to yours. These ships are from guests who have come to visit the system to have a drink, at the moment there are only a few, but they will be expanded with easter eggs, references and funny dialogues, a way to give life and personality to the settlement of Terbin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/9bba0bb78d490598c70dd21d658785f5e7d7a0be.png[/img]

And Terbin has even more things: Until now they were still sprites, but from 0.3 they will move around the town in random routes, bringing a lot of life to the town.

[b]MORE STORY AND NEW CHARACTERS[/b]

Finally, a new story fragment is available in Galea, where you can also meet three new characters and their adorable companions, who were hiding behind the workers' fences, although that's best to find out for yourselves.

[b]IMPORTANT
[/b]
This update brings multiple new systems, so we expect at least a couple of weeks of bugs and inconsistencies that we will be fixing in small patches, even if Farlands is being completed slowly, it is still an Early Access. Nothing particularly serious should happen, but keep in mind, as always, that we will gradually patch anything that is buggy.

Also, one of the systems that was supposed to be added in this update: Weather, is not yet finished, so we have decided to delay it a bit, so it will arrive in a patch a bit later.

That being said, thank you very much for your time and enjoy the new update while we work on the next one!

notes.title: The tool upgrade system!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! I'm bringing you a little preview of what we are preparing for the 0.3 update!

Although the last few weeks have been somewhat silent on our part, we are still working at 200% following the roadmap that will lead us to Farlands 1.0, and we are currently working on the 0.3 update, the first update that will bring major mechanical upgrades to the game.

The list of things that will be added is as follows:

- Dynamic NPCs that will change position and move around the village: no more static dummies.
- House upgrade system.
- Tool upgrade system.
- Indoor furniture and new system for objects that will allow you to rotate them.
- Food!
- A new story fragment.
- Weather.
- Preliminary achievement system.
- New furniture sets (both indoor and outdoor).

That's a LOT of stuff to add to Farlands all together, and we're working hard on getting it done. Until it's perfect, though, it won't be added to the game. In this update, I want to show you a little bit of the tool upgrades system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/e1f9eb12414f1fa5923acc2504dbad07d2909949.gif[/img]

With the 0.3 update, every tool will be upgradable by talking to Gorg, who, using his “skills”, will upgrade any of our tools by one level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/9e8bbe68a5ab93e2abcdb4b2920c7a4afd31ffab.gif[/img]

Once the tool is upgraded, it will not only increase its power (which will allow us to break rocks or cut down trees more easily), but it will also increase its range of action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/7e87dbe8fd10fbdc358a4d2b0fabc7a3aea1f8f0.gif[/img]

With these upgrades, getting through mines, clearing the farm, and growing fruits and vegetables can be done in much more effective and enjoyable ways (smashing your way down mines is incredibly satisfying).

With that said: we're keeping working! Some of the other mechanics are completely finished now and we are starting to consider possible release dates for the update, so stay tuned for more news in the coming weeks.

Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Farlands update 0.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
It's been two months since the Early Access launch of Farlands and the whole team is thrilled with the reception it's had, so we'd like to thank you for your support right from the start!

But even though the launch went very well, we haven't stopped working since release, and to date we've released no less than 17 patches with fixes for dozens and dozens of bugs!

On top of those patches, the Farlands 0.2 update brings some new content, a celebratory discount for those of you who are hesitating whether or not to buy Farlands and these new features:

[b]Starting with the Ark, map and neighbors tabs in the main menu:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/5f761521ee48b070f9767de278c9842b04e64a3a.png[/img]

In the neighbors tab you will be able to see a provisional list of all Farlands NPCs, in update 0.4, (the update that will include the social elements), this tab will be updated, but for now it will be enabled as a list of all the characters in the game.

In the map tab you will be able to see the entire SR755 system, its planets, where you are located and how many fuel cells the ship has left, to know its location even if you are far away from it.

And finally, in the Ark tab you will be able to see all the collections of items you have donated, to keep track of your progress. And later on, you will be able to see your achievements, although you will have to wait a bit longer for that.

Along with these tabs, the main menu starts to show some information about each game, to make it easier to differentiate them and see where they are in the game.

[b]The crafting machine is now upgraded![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/017b608bebf2853ed7b2ea82f0877bb9c89a4908.gif[/img]

Scattered around the stores, you can now find upgrade chips for your crafting machine. If you buy them and place them in the machine, you will unlock new crafting recipes.

And obviously, with this new system, a new set of outdoor furniture is added, the mushroom furniture set, which is crafted using mainly Bohr's moon mushrooms.

Finally, a new fragment of the main story has been added to the adventure, you will be able to unlock it by playing normally, whether you make a new game, or continue with yours.

[b]Steam cards, badges and stuff![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/c306bfba99d3dcb9f273d87941df486d7af00af9.png[/img]

Along with these changes, although outside the game itself, from now on you will get Steam trading cards while playing Farlands. With those cards you will be able to earn badges and unlock backgrounds and icons to customize your Steam page.

The update 0.2, is the update that brings less content of all the Farlands roadmap, this was done on purpose to make room for those first weeks of fighting against bugs and important fixes.

However, I hope you can enjoy these small additions and stay tuned for the next update, 0.3, which will bring mountains of content that will extend the life of Farlands a lot.

Thank you very much for your support and see you in the next update!

notes.title: The 0.2 update is coming!
notes.notes:
It's been three weeks since the Early Access launch and we've been working hard to ensure that the experience is as stable as possible in this period when the game is still quite young.

We have fixed dozens of bugs. While there aren't updates for every patch, we've gone from 0.1.0 to 0.1.14 That's 14 updates with fixes!

And now, although we are still working on fixing all the issues you are reporting, we are also combining our time with expanding the Farlands content, and the first major update, the 0.2, will arrive IN SEPTEMBER.

This update will mainly bring three things:

[b]The missing tabs in the inventory.[/b]

That is the museum collections tab, the NPCs, the map and the messages system. Some of them will be in preliminary forms, but at least we will be able to unhook the “coming soon” sign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/5f761521ee48b070f9767de278c9842b04e64a3a.png[/img]
[b]
Memory chips[/b]

Thinking about 0.3, which will bring interior decoration and house extensions, for now what 0.2 will have is the system for expanding the crafting machine. Using memory chips that you will be able to buy from vendors, you will unlock new furniture sets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/017b608bebf2853ed7b2ea82f0877bb9c89a4908.gif[/img]
[b]
Cards, badges, backgrounds and icons
[/b]
Along with all this, from 0.2, playing Farlands you will be able to get Steam trading cards, with which you can make badges and unlock backgrounds and icons. Let's see if you can get the reflective badge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/c306bfba99d3dcb9f273d87941df486d7af00af9.png[/img]

Of all the updates to come, this is the one with the least content of all. This is because we knew we would have to dedicate a good part of our time to fix the major issues, and because we were able to introduce some of the most important elements in 0.1 (the calendar, Larry & Barry and a few other things).

But from this point on, look forward to the next updates, because all of them will be loaded with new mechanics and content that you will be able to sink your teeth into.

Thank you all for your support and keep up the good work!

notes.title: Farlands Early Access is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After a year and a half of development, and with the whole team equally nervous and exhausted, the Farlands Early Access is OUT NOW!

It comes with a base price of $14.99 and 10% discount (Price adjusted to different regions).

We are a small team, and the Early Access comes with its fair share of bugs, so if you feel like it, you can access the Farlands Discord to report everything you find, and in the next updates we'll be working on fixing everything!

You also have the soundtrack available, and a convenient pack with game plus soundtrack at a discounted price!

Thank you very much for your support and enjoy Farlands!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252680/Farlands/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/0c18c36118d9ce4c2ca0601234758201a9f89bc4.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
Below you will see a detailed list of all the updates coming during Early Access and what systems and content they will bring:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/5d62b7322fdc7429762417587a102c2f302aaeb1.png[/img]

This roadmap is tentative and subject to change during development, community feedback is very important and it is possible that we will modify the order of updates, add/remove things and generally make changes during the Early Access period.

However, it should serve as an indication of what content Farlands will have in the final release, and what we will be working on at each point in Early Access.

The first version you'll be able to play of Farlands, version 0.1, will be a slightly more sandbox experience, as many of the game's core systems will not yet be in place, the first updates will mainly be bug-fixing patches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/1def8c30af214485133a6ea426681b3690c1cdb7.png[/img]

The first Farlands update will be based on the calendar, which will start to show the days of the week. That will allow us to start working on the seasonal events and a few other things.

Along with this system, Larry & Barry will have the random stock that they promise in their event, and we will fine tune some vegetable stuff.

Finally, the main menu will show some of the tabs listed as "coming soon" and the expandable memory chip system will be added, to unlock new craftable recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/d5c58316a37a8fe4ae461d2dcee879a481c574ec.png[/img]

The third update will focus on house upgrades, which we will be able to do by talking to Grubert, the carpenter. And why do we want a bigger house if we can't decorate it? Well, don't worry, because together with the upgrade system, we will add the memory chips with indoor furniture.

In parallel, the tool upgrade systems, food recipes and of course, the ability to eat, and the weather (thanks to the previous update with the calendar) will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/4d045554971dd67e26d36f20cbf4eeaa3bccad15.png[/img]

This update will be a big one, because it will add the whole layer of social relationships with characters, events and dialogues depending on the level of friendship. Initially only the first events will be available with each NPC, and the rest will be added with each update.

Accompanying this system, another of the menu tabs will be unlocked, the messaging tab. Through which we will be able to send and receive emails with neighbors.

Alongside these systems, new furniture sets and story events will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/ca7a4c094a2cac5603f2fae5fd0bccac77fe28f4.png[/img]

One of the important points of Farlands is "peaceful" combat, but that can't be done if there is only one enemy in the mines. In this update, new hostile mobs will be added and the second mine in Hafnir will be unlocked.

Additionally, new furniture, candidate and story events will be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/e4d2fb18fc3c9c1ef076693f3a5bb73cb7194265.png[/img]

A new planet will be available! Vanadian, the desert planet, whose days last so long that depending on when you arrive, you will see a perpetual day or night.

Vanadian will come with new resources to collect, insects, fish and a merchant with his own stock of rarities.

Additionally, new events with neighbors, a new story event, and new furniture sets will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/c445e600557970f57439f56c098ed7ba9b0f6e53.png[/img]

If things go well up to this point, 0.7 will serve the team to clean up, fix and improve the systems that are already implemented, here we will use this update to iron out the rough edges and leave everything well rounded. But of course, it will also bring things for you:

As with every update, new events with neighbors, story events and furniture sets will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/b60ea1c0692362df1cee614c8ce83bd1421bd1c0.png[/img]

And after polishing and cleaning, we return to the charge with new systems; the construction of stables and the space animal care system. After this update we will be able to build stables of different classes on the farm and adopt creatures that will give us resources with which to earn money.

Along with this, the same of the previous updates: New story events, with neighbors and furniture to go rounding out the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/2f3653a4193609c3c4d9c588fb26dd6a1d8ee6a1.png[/img]

And after all the progress that has been made in relationships with neighbors, the time has come for weddings. With a romanceable candidate with whom we have the relationship to the maximum, we will be able to get married and when we do it... things will happen.

Along with this, it will advance the story a bit more and some furniture and decorations will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/2b2a38ce3ef6c5fbc6971ea5b160ba522ccf7840.png[/img]

And finally we come to update 1.0, which will allow you to complete the game, although it will not be the end of the development, as there will still be pending things that will be added after this update.

Here what we will have is a new planet, Darmstad, with the third mine of the game and its own set of oxygen mechanics. At the same time, the story will progress to the endgame and Farlands can be completed (although not 100%).

[b]WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?[/b]

After this, we have a lot of things left to do: Steam achievements, story events up to 100% completion of the ark, a whole planet!

All these things will be added throughout the updates when we make adjustments to the roadmap, or after completing it, closing the last stages of development and completing everything we have pending.

As I said at the beginning, this roadmap is tentative, it is only an approximation of what we will be doing, and because of the way we work, many systems will be moving from one side to another in order to have a smooth development, both for us and for you.

Still, I hope you will join us in this adventure, and play Farlands along with us with each update, to see how things are progressing, and how the game is completed around us.

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Farlands Early Access arrives on July 24th!
notes.notes:
After the success of the demo, and as we announced at the Future Games Show, Farlands will be released in Early Access next Wednesday, July 24th, three weeks from now as of this post.

The whole team is excited and nervous in equal parts (some more nervous than excited).

When Farlands comes out, we will have been in development for only a year and a half, a record time for a project of this size. Consequently, many things will have to be refined and updated slowly.

Even so, we have a roadmap prepared with all the content and major updates that will be coming to Farlands during the Early Access period. Before we get started, we want to thank you for your patience and understanding for the turbulences that may occur during the development process.

Thank you all very much and we will share the roadmap with all the details soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/0c18c36118d9ce4c2ca0601234758201a9f89bc4.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest comes to an end
notes.notes:
The Farlands demo is no longer available, thank you all for giving our game a try!

During this week we have had more than 20.000 players downloading the demo, almost 15.000 new wishlists have been added and we have received more than 600 bug reports and suggestions (this last figure may not be so good ^^" ).

Now it's time to move on to the next phase, which is to prepare for the Early Access launch, which will arrive on July 24th, five weeks from now.

Since we are a small team, and the demo has aroused a lot of interest, I can already warn you that in those five weeks we will not have time to fix all the problems that have appeared during these days of play, but we will do our best and after the launch, we will continue working with the same attitude and dedication to correct all the problems and slowly make Farlands a game that we can be proud of.

Thank you all very much for playing, for your patience and for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/be664d9d9077cd97c3bd82af4d24ccc329caf84d.png[/img]

notes.title: Check out the demo of Farlands!
notes.notes:
The Farlands demo has been available since we announced it last week, but it's now Friday and the Steam Next Fest is coming to an end in a few days. Which means that the demo... will no longer be available.

Oh no! Why?

Simply because we have to focus our efforts on the Early Access, which will arrive on July 24th.

During all this week we have received a lot of reports and suggestions that we have been studying conscientiously. Until today, we have released daily updates fixing the problems that players reported and escaped to QA, but from next week, we will not be able to continue with that dynamic.

If we focus on the demo, we won't get to Early Access with the level of quality we want, and if we keep the demo public, and we don't update it, and you will have to suffer some bugs and problems that we won't fix because we are focusing on Early Access.

As we don't want to have to juggle, and the most important thing is that the game comes out perfect, we have decided to take the demo down for the moment. There will be new opportunities to test Farlands in other more polished demos at a later date, once Early Access has been released.

Thank you all so much for the reception Farlands has received, and we'll keep you posted on updates until Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/e73a68235b4337fff724f61438d9d49b2d80ccea.png[/img]

notes.title: We have shown Farlands at the Future Games Show!
notes.notes:
Farlands has been announced at the Future Games Show during the Summer Games Fest week. And in that announcement we have taken the opportunity to announce EVERYTHING: 

On one hand, you already have the DEMO available, it will be playable during the whole Steam demo fest, and even after the event is over.

In the demo you will have 10 days of gameplay where you can do anything you want. It's hard to see what a farm game experience is like in a demo, but we hope you enjoy the experience.

And on the other hand, the Early Access release date for Farlands is:

[b]July 24, 2024[/b]

As of this writing we have 6 weeks to go. Time that we will devote to bug fixing, polishing and doing everything we can to make the Farlands experience as smooth as possible, even from the beginning of the Early Access.

Thank you all for your support, and we'll keep working!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/0c18c36118d9ce4c2ca0601234758201a9f89bc4.png[/img]

notes.title: Come and try Farlands at GUADALINDIE!
notes.notes:
Thanks to ICOA (The Catalan Institute of Alternative Leisure), next 3rd and 4th of May, Farlands will have a small booth at Guadalindie in Malaga, a new fair focused on the world of independent videogames.

Farlands development is now in a tricky stage, so we can't prepare a demo just for this event, but we will bring the latest development build (and as polished as possible!).

So if you're local, want to say hello, or want to try Farlands before Early Access, this will be the perfect time. Also, we'll be bringing rewards for those of you who find bugs and manage to break the game.

notes.title: Farlands development diaries: Now in English!
notes.notes:
In January 2023, we started working on Farlands, and to show the development process, we also started uploading a series of videos for the Hispanic community showing what we were doing.

This year, all those videos are being localized and translated so that non-Spanish speaking communities can also see the entire process of the Farlands development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546864/d98aa19fb9ebbb15a0125b9ded4c546e50915c05.png[/img]

If you're interested in taking a peek behind the curtains, you can find those videos (and every trailer we make), on the Farlands YouTube channel: 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Farlandsgame]https://www.youtube.com/@Farlandsgame[/url]

At the moment there are only two videos available explaining the initial ideas and how the development started. The rest of the videos will be uploaded at a rate of one video every 15 days until the localized version reaches the Hispanic version, after that, one video per month will be uploaded. 

We hope you enjoy the series as much as the Hispanic community is enjoying it!

Thank you very much!
